column2: the plan treats `make lint-skill-closure-growth` as sufficient ratchet confirmation after compressing `flags.md` and regenerating `python/skill-closure-baseline.json`. growth lint is one-directional: it only fails when live metrics exceed the committed baseline, so a shrink can pass locally even if baseline regen was skipped or not committed. ci then fails on `test_committed_baseline_matches_fresh_scan` in `python/tests/lint/test_lint_skill_closure_growth.py`, while testing strategy and failure modes misstate the actual gate.
